show: 商英get到手 职场任我走
titel: 英文常用动词&词组（四） 英语口语常用表达 商务英语 职场英语 外贸英语

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts; M4A: Ausschnitte nur als AAC-Bloecke (clips_aac) - eine App ohne ADTS-Umverpackung zeigt keine; Texte aus dem Begleittext des Podcasters, kein Transkript - ohne Zeitachse sind Clips und Sprungmarken unmoeglich

einzeiler: 职场与商务英语中常用动词及词组的用法与例句。
kurzfassung: 本期节目介绍了职场和商务英语中常用的十个动词及词组。内容涵盖求职、管理、团队协作以及日常工作中的表达方式。每个词汇均配有相应的应用场景和例句。
stichpunkte: put in a good word 的用法与例句
restructure 在公司重组中的应用
differentiate 的产品与变量区分
highlight 与 pay attention to 的重点强调
carry out 与 revamp 的项目执行和改革
beschreibung:
1. Put in a good word说好话
l I will put in a good word for you with the recruiter.
l Please put in a good word for me with the supervisor.
2. Restructure 整顿 整形
l The company is restructuring its accounting department.
l She was laid off裁员when the company restructured sales department.
3. Troubleshoot故障查找 动词
l Follow the error messages to troubleshoot.
l We need to troubleshoot and strengthen the whole team.
4. Delegate委派
l We were delegated to clean up the data.
l He was always overburdened with too many trivial 琐碎的tasks because he found it impossible to delegate.
5. Differentiate区别
l We need to differentiate our product from our competitors’.
l This model helps us to differentiate two different variables.
6. Highlight强调
l Let me highlight important information from the meeting.
l Could you highlight your past experience?
7. Pay attention to注意
l Please pay attention to an email from HR about themandatory survey.
l Could you pay attention to details when preparing the report?
8. Evaluate评估/评价
l The market situation is difficult to evaluate.
l End of year, every employee needs to objectively evaluate their work.
9. Carry out 贯彻,完成
l The project was carried out over a two months period. 历时2月
l Make sure those candidates are competent to carry out the work.
10. Revamp 改革/改造/修补/改进/翻新
l We are revamping the management system and we would like to hear your thoughts on that.
l The whole process needs to be revamped.
